description.en: A field of view for each situation (normal view, sprint, crouch, lock-on), transition time, camera distance, height and side (for every situation, or each its own), comfort options, vivid colours, a clean image and cinematic looks. Cutscenes, dialogues and special moves keep the game's camera.
description.zh-Hans: 为不同状态（普通镜头、冲刺、下蹲、锁定敌人）分别设置视野，并可调整过渡时间，以及镜头的距离、高度和左右位置（可通用，也可按状态分别设置），还有舒适选项，并能让色彩更鲜艳、画面更纯净，还可选用电影色调。过场动画、对话和特殊招式保持游戏原有镜头。

help.en: Off: the game's own field of view, camera position, colours and image everywhere.
help.zh-Hans: 关闭：各处均使用游戏原有的视野、镜头位置、色彩和画面。

help.en: Field of view of each preset: Game 75 (sprint 75), the game's own, Very Close 49 (sprint 64), Close 62 (sprint 77), Default 75 (sprint 90), Far 90 (sprint 105). Crouch and lock-on take the normal view's value. Custom uses the rows under Custom.
help.zh-Hans: 各预设的视野：原版 75（冲刺 75），即游戏原值，极近 49（冲刺 64），近 62（冲刺 77），默认 75（冲刺 90），远 90（冲刺 105）。下蹲和锁定沿用普通镜头的数值。自定义：使用“自定义”下方的设置。

help.en: Seconds the view takes to change from one situation to another, with every preset. The game's is 1.5 (crouching: about 0.3). With Per situation on and a situation's row not at 0, the camera position takes the same time from one situation to another.
help.zh-Hans: 视野从一种状态切换到另一种状态所需的秒数，适用于所有预设。游戏原值为 1.5（下蹲时约 0.3）。开启“分状态设置”且有任一状态的项不为 0 时，镜头位置在状态之间的切换也使用同样的时间。

help.en: In % of each view's own distance: negative brings the camera closer, positive takes it farther. 0 is the game's. These three rows apply in every situation; dialogues, cutscenes and special moves keep the game's camera.
help.zh-Hans: 按各镜头原有距离的百分比计：负值拉近镜头，正值拉远镜头。0 为游戏原值。这三项在所有状态下通用；对话、过场动画和特殊招式保持游戏原有镜头。

help.en: In cm: positive raises the camera, negative lowers it. 0 is the game's.
help.zh-Hans: 单位为厘米：正值升高镜头，负值降低镜头。0 为游戏原值。

help.en: In cm: positive moves the camera to the right, negative to the left. The game's camera sits to the right of the character; about -80 puts the character in the middle. 0 is the game's.
help.zh-Hans: 单位为厘米：正值使镜头右移，负值左移。游戏镜头位于角色右侧，约 -80 时角色位于画面中央。0 为游戏原值。

help.en: On: each row below is added to Distance, Height or Side in its own situation; a row at 0 leaves that situation as those three set it. Once a row below is not 0, the camera takes Transition time to go from one situation's position to another's. Off: the rows below do nothing.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：下方各项会在对应状态下叠加到“距离”“高度”“左右位置”上；为 0 时该状态沿用这三项的设置。只要下方有一项不为 0，镜头在不同状态的位置之间切换时就按“过渡时间”移动。关闭：下方各项不起作用。

help.en: With Per situation on: standing, walking, running and climbing, with no enemy near. Added to Distance, in % of this view's own distance; the two together stay from -50 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：站立、行走、奔跑和攀爬时，且附近没有敌人。叠加到“距离”上，按该镜头原有距离的百分比计；两者之和限制在 -50 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: standing, walking, running and climbing, with no enemy near. Added to Height, in cm; the two together stay from -100 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：站立、行走、奔跑和攀爬时，且附近没有敌人。叠加到“高度”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -100 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: standing, walking, running and climbing, with no enemy near. Added to Side, in cm; the two together stay from -200 to 200.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：站立、行走、奔跑和攀爬时，且附近没有敌人。叠加到“左右位置”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -200 到 200 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: while sprinting, near enemies too. Added to Distance, in % of this view's own distance; the two together stay from -50 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：冲刺时，附近有敌人时也一样。叠加到“距离”上，按该镜头原有距离的百分比计；两者之和限制在 -50 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: while sprinting, near enemies too. Added to Height, in cm; the two together stay from -100 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：冲刺时，附近有敌人时也一样。叠加到“高度”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -100 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: while sprinting, near enemies too. Added to Side, in cm; the two together stay from -200 to 200.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：冲刺时，附近有敌人时也一样。叠加到“左右位置”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -200 到 200 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: while crouching. Added to Distance, in % of this view's own distance; the two together stay from -50 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：下蹲时。叠加到“距离”上，按该镜头原有距离的百分比计；两者之和限制在 -50 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: while crouching. Added to Height, in cm; the two together stay from -100 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：下蹲时。叠加到“高度”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -100 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: while crouching. Added to Side, in cm; the two together stay from -200 to 200.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：下蹲时。叠加到“左右位置”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -200 到 200 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: enemies near and none locked on. The game keeps this view until you move away from them; sprinting takes the sprint's. Added to Distance, in % of this view's own distance; the two together stay from -50 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：附近有敌人且未锁定时。在远离敌人之前，游戏会一直保持此镜头；冲刺时则使用冲刺的设置。叠加到“距离”上，按该镜头原有距离的百分比计；两者之和限制在 -50 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: enemies near and none locked on. The game keeps this view until you move away from them; sprinting takes the sprint's. Added to Height, in cm; the two together stay from -100 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：附近有敌人且未锁定时。在远离敌人之前，游戏会一直保持此镜头；冲刺时则使用冲刺的设置。叠加到“高度”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -100 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: enemies near and none locked on. The game keeps this view until you move away from them; sprinting takes the sprint's. Added to Side, in cm; the two together stay from -200 to 200.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：附近有敌人且未锁定时。在远离敌人之前，游戏会一直保持此镜头；冲刺时则使用冲刺的设置。叠加到“左右位置”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -200 到 200 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: with an enemy locked on. Added to Distance, in % of this view's own distance; the two together stay from -50 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：锁定敌人时。叠加到“距离”上，按该镜头原有距离的百分比计；两者之和限制在 -50 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: with an enemy locked on. Added to Height, in cm; the two together stay from -100 to 100.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：锁定敌人时。叠加到“高度”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -100 到 100 之间。

help.en: With Per situation on: with an enemy locked on. Added to Side, in cm; the two together stay from -200 to 200.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“分状态设置”后：锁定敌人时。叠加到“左右位置”上，单位为厘米；两者之和限制在 -200 到 200 之间。

help.en: On: the camera trails the character by 50 cm at most (the game: up to 300), so the character stays near the middle of the screen when running, turning or stopping. Normal view, sprint and crouch. May show only from the next change of view, such as starting a sprint.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：镜头最多落后角色 50 厘米（游戏原值最多 300），奔跑、转向或急停时角色保持在画面中央附近。适用于普通镜头、冲刺和下蹲。可能在下一次切换镜头（例如开始冲刺）时才生效。

help.en: On: while sprinting, the game no longer turns the camera behind the character; it stays where you point it. May show only from the next change of view, such as starting a sprint.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冲刺时游戏不再自动把镜头转到角色背后，镜头保持在你调整的方向。可能在下一次切换镜头（例如开始冲刺）时才生效。

help.en: On: while sprinting, the camera keeps the normal view's distance (350 instead of 400); Distance then counts from 350 in sprint too. May show only from the next change of view, such as starting a sprint.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冲刺时镜头保持普通镜头的距离（350，而非 400）；此时“距离”在冲刺时也以 350 为基准。可能在下一次切换镜头（例如开始冲刺）时才生效。

help.en: On: no camera shake while sprinting. May show only from the next change of view, such as starting a sprint.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冲刺时镜头不再晃动。可能在下一次切换镜头（例如开始冲刺）时才生效。

help.en: With Preset on Custom: standing, walking, running, climbing, and fighting with no enemy locked on. The game's is 75.
help.zh-Hans: 预设为“自定义”时生效：站立、行走、奔跑、攀爬，以及战斗中未锁定敌人时的视野。游戏原值为 75。

help.en: With Preset on Custom: while sprinting. The game keeps 75, the same as the normal view.
help.zh-Hans: 预设为“自定义”时生效：冲刺时的视野。游戏原值为 75，与普通镜头相同。

help.en: With Preset on Custom: while crouching. The game's is 75.
help.zh-Hans: 预设为“自定义”时生效：下蹲时的视野。游戏原值为 75。

help.en: With Preset on Custom: with an enemy locked on, standing or moving. Unlocking goes back to the normal view. The game's is 75.
help.zh-Hans: 预设为“自定义”时生效：锁定敌人时（站立或移动）的视野。解除锁定后恢复普通镜头的视野。游戏原值为 75。

help.en: More vivid colours everywhere: the colour saturation set to 120% up to 200% of normal; each place keeps its own tones. Game: the game's colours. Works with every preset.
help.zh-Hans: 让各处色彩更鲜艳：将色彩饱和度设为正常值的 120% 到 200%，各场景保留自身色调。原版：游戏原有色彩。适用于所有预设。

help.en: On: no vignette (darker screen edges), film grain, bloom (glow around lights), chromatic aberration or lens flares. Off: the game's image.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：无暗角（画面边缘变暗）、胶片颗粒、泛光（光源周围的辉光）、色差和镜头光晕。关闭：游戏原有画面。

help.en: On: the colour grade picked in Look, over each place's own tones. Off: the game's grade. Works with Colours and with every preset.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：使用“色调”中选择的调色风格，并保留各场景自身的色调。关闭：游戏原有色调。可与“色彩”及所有预设同时使用。

help.en: With Cinematic look on. Teal and orange: blue-green shadows, orange lights. Warm: golden. Cold: steel blue, less colour. Faded: washed-out colours, strong contrast. Black and white. Vintage: old film, soft and warm.
help.zh-Hans: 开启“电影色调”时生效。青橙：阴影偏青，高光偏橙。暖色：金黄色调。冷色：钢蓝色调，色彩稍淡。褪色：色彩淡化，对比强烈。黑白。复古：老电影风格，柔和偏暖。
